testCase:
G-028: Initial-only round button by its accessible name
Goal: Open the Household settings of the Renwick kitchen.
STEP 1: Navigate to /gopro/patterns/p28.html
STEP 2: Click the "Profile menu" button
STEP 3: Verify that 'Signed in as tobias.renwick@example.net' is visible
STEP 4: Click the "Household settings" link
STEP 5: Verify that 'Household settings for the Renwick kitchen' is visible

steps.note: Activate the initial-only button by its accessible name.
Verify the profile menu shows the expected signed-in identity.

args.text: Household settings for the Renwick kitchen

steps.note: Verify the intended Household settings destination is visible.

reasoning: This test checks that the initial-only profile button can be activated by its accessible name and leads to the Renwick kitchen’s Household settings. The plan follows the specified navigation and verifies both the signed-in identity and the destination text.
